status: Closed — ATM-GOV-0369 done and frozen close regression re-verified
area: Taskflow close / isolated index commit assembly
finding: Taskflow close builds a temporary Git index and invokes a bare commit. An actor registry update made by the official identity command can be explicitly authorized by the current task claim and direction lock, yet the bundle omitted the tracked dirty registry file. The pre-commit hook then rejected the isolated commit as ATM_COMMIT_ACTOR_REGISTRY_UNSTAGED, leaving a valid close transaction unable to finish.
expectedBehavior: A tracked .atm/catalog/registry/actors.json change joins a taskflow isolated close bundle only when it is dirty and the current task's declared runtime scope explicitly permits it. Untracked registry files, unchanged registries, and registry changes outside the current task's claim or direction lock remain excluded.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0369 reached taskflow close write after a successful runner publication. The close backend rolled back because its temporary-index bare Git commit did not stage .atm/catalog/registry/actors.json, while the pre-commit hook correctly required that currently authorized actor-registry change. The focused commit-bundle assembly fixture seeds a tracked registry, modifies it, grants the exact task claim and direction lock, and verifies that only then the bundle contains the registry path.
followUp: Closed on 2026-09-02: ATM-GOV-0369 is done/released with no closeback residue in the authoritative live ledger, and packages/cli/src/commands/taskflow/__tests__/commit-bundle-assembly.spec.ts passes through the current frozen runner.
